title: GTA6 Limited Edition Controller Revealed at State of Play
description: Sony hosted back-to-back State of Play showcases, revealing major updates, Japanese developer highlights, and a surprise GTA6 limited edition controller.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Sony's Double Feature State of Play Delivers Major Reveals and a GTA6 Controller

Gaming media outlet Push Square has reported on a historic event for Sony: for the very first time, the company has run two State of Play livestreams back-to-back. The broadcast was split into a standard showcase packed with general announcements followed immediately by a State of Play Japan event dedicated to Japanese and Asian developers. Together, these dual showcases brought a massive wave of new reveals to the gaming community.

### A Packed Showcase of Updates

During the main State of Play livestream, audiences were treated to a variety of significant updates. Major highlights included fresh content for *Gran Turismo 7*, a closer look at *Saros*, and another appearance from *Final Fantasy 7 Revelation*. Alongside these prominent titles were several smaller updates and hardware reveals that managed to capture the attention of players worldwide—most notably, the appearance of a GTA6 limited edition controller.

### What the GTA6 Controller Means for Fans

While the detailed specifications, pricing, and release dates of the GTA6 limited edition controller were sparse during the broadcast, its mere existence on the official State of Play stage is a notable development. For a fanbase constantly searching for any official nods to Rockstar's upcoming blockbuster, hardware tie-ins like this controller suggest that official promotional momentum may be steadily building behind the scenes. 

## Editor's Take

Sony's back-to-back State of Play experiment proved to be a massive success in terms of content volume. Sneaking in a GTA6 limited edition controller among the general announcements was a brilliant move to keep community excitement high. Even minor merchandise drops like this keep the anticipation engine running strong as we await further news from Rockstar.
